comment: The MORPH CV jack multiplies the MORPH knob instead of adding to it, and the divisor is 8 rather than 10: getShapeAmount returns shapeControlTaper(shapeKnob * (cv / 8)). So a patched cable resting at 0V, or any negative voltage, holds the morph at zero and leaves the knob dead, and the knob is only reached at 8V. The EXPO jack has no attenuator and is summed into the same exponent as V/OCT, so despite the panel calling it exponential FM it tracks a volt per octave exactly as the pitch input does. The S GATE jack is normalled to 10V, so the sub runs whenever nothing is patched, and a patched cable held low silences the SUB output. The FREQ knob covers 10Hz to 10000Hz while the pitch as a whole is clamped to 8Hz to 20000Hz, so modulation can reach a little beyond either end of the knob. The OCT button and the Coarse Tune menu items set the same parameter. The waveform display is a plain widget with no parameter behind it.
